_naming_fragility_note: DORMANT HAZARD, recorded where the next person changing a node_type will see it: grain_sentinel.check_magnitude (:127) iterates THESE baseline keys and looks up each exact key in the node stream, and :120-121 SKIPS classes absent from the baseline. The keys here are SCREAMING_SNAKE and the stitch stream currently uses SCREAMING_SNAKE, so they agree and nothing fires. But the canonical comp-kuzu DB uses CamelCase for the same concept (`ReactQueryKey` vs `REACT_QUERY_KEY`) -- so if a future change points the sentinel at a differently-named stream, or renames a node_type on either side, the lookup yields 0, the ratio renders 0.00x, and it is BYTE-IDENTICAL TO A REAL COLLAPSE. A hazard that is currently dormant because two conventions happen to agree is still a hazard. Surfaced 2026-07-25 by 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp; ruled not-firing-today by 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z.
